intimidating.meaning: 令人畏懼的 / 嚇人的

examples.source: The interview panel looked quite intimidating, but I tried to stay calm.
examples.target: 面試小組看起來令人畏懼，但我盡量保持冷靜。

examples.source: She found the sheer size of the university campus a bit intimidating at first.
examples.target: 她起初覺得大學校園大得令人有點畏懼。

examples.source: Don't let the technical terms make the subject seem more intimidating than it really is.
examples.target: 別讓那些術語令這門學科看起來比實際更嚇人。

examples.source: The watch has an intricate design that shows the time clearly.
examples.target: 這隻手錶有精細的設計，能清楚顯示時間。

examples.source: She drew an intricate pattern on the paper with a pen.
examples.target: 她用筆在紙上畫出了一個複雜的圖案。

examples.source: It is difficult to understand the intricate rules of this game.
examples.target: 這款遊戲的規則很複雜，很難理解。

examples.source: I was intrigued by the story about the lost cat.
examples.target: 我對那個關於走失貓咪的故事感到很有興趣。

examples.source: She is intrigued by science because it explains how things work.
examples.target: 她對科學感到很有興趣，因為它解釋了事物如何運作。

examples.source: The students were intrigued by the teacher's new magic trick.
examples.target: 學生們對老師的新魔術感到很有興趣。

examples.source: Curiosity is an intrinsic part of being a young student.
examples.target: 好奇心是學生內在的一部分。

examples.source: Learning has an intrinsic value that goes beyond getting grades.
examples.target: 學習有一種超越分數的內在價值。

examples.source: Creativity is an intrinsic quality that helps us solve problems.
examples.target: 創造力是一種幫助我們解決問題的內在特質。

examples.source: Creativity is an intrinsic part of human nature.
examples.target: 創造力是人類天性中固有的部分。

examples.source: There is intrinsic value in learning a new language.
examples.target: 學習一門新語言具有內在價值。

examples.source: The intrinsic quality of the fabric makes it very durable.
examples.target: 這種布料的內在品質使其非常耐用。

examples.source: Old photos have intrinsic value because they hold many family memories.
examples.target: 舊照片具有內在價值，因為它們承載了許多家庭回憶。

examples.source: We should learn to see the intrinsic value of every person.
examples.target: 我們應該學會看見每個人身上的內在價值。

examples.source: Gold has intrinsic value, even if its market price changes daily.
examples.target: 即使市場價格每天都在變，黃金仍然具有內在價值。

examples.source: Please do not intrude on our private family meeting.
examples.target: 請不要打擾我們的私人家庭會議。

examples.source: I felt bad when I had to intrude on their conversation.
examples.target: 當我不得不打擾他們的對話時，我感到很不好意思。

examples.source: Strangers should not intrude into our school campus without permission.
examples.target: 陌生人未經許可不應闖入我們的校園。

examples.source: Your ticket is invalid because you bought it for the wrong date.
examples.target: 因為你買錯了日期，所以你的車票是無效的。

examples.source: The password you entered is invalid, so please try again.
examples.target: 你輸入的密碼無效，請再試一次。

examples.source: If you do not sign the form, it will be considered invalid.
examples.target: 如果你沒有在表格上簽署，它將會被視為無效。

examples.source: This book is invaluable because it helps me learn English.
examples.target: 這本書非常珍貴，因為它能幫助我學習英語。

examples.source: Your advice was invaluable when I prepared for the exam.
examples.target: 當我準備考試時，你的建議顯得非常珍貴。

examples.source: Experience is invaluable if you want to find a job.
examples.target: 如果你想找工作，經驗是無價的。

examples.source: Your advice has been invaluable to me during this difficult time.
examples.target: 在這段困難時期，你的建議對我來說極其寶貴。

examples.source: The experience I gained from the internship was invaluable for my future career.
examples.target: 我在實習中獲得的經驗對我未來的職業生涯而言是無價的。

examples.source: This old map is an invaluable historical document.
examples.target: 這張舊地圖是一份極其珍貴的歷史文獻。

examples.source: These invasive plants grow quickly and kill the local flowers.
examples.target: 這些入侵性植物生長得很快，並會殺死本地的花卉。

examples.source: We should stop invasive species from damaging our natural environment.
examples.target: 我們應該阻止入侵物種破壞我們的自然環境。

examples.source: Some people find these questions too invasive and personal.
examples.target: 有些人覺得這些問題太過入侵性且涉及私隱。

examples.source: The invasive species is harming the local plants in the park.
examples.target: 這種入侵物種正在破壞公園裡的本地植物。

examples.source: We must stop the invasive species because they kill native animals.
examples.target: 我們必須阻止這些入侵物種，因為牠們會殺死本地動物。

examples.source: If an invasive species spreads, it can change the whole environment.
examples.target: 如果入侵物種擴散開來，可能會改變整個生態環境。

examples.source: My father wants to invest money in a new business.
examples.target: 我爸爸想投資金錢在一門新生意上。

examples.source: You should invest time to learn a new language today.
examples.target: 你今天應該投資時間去學習一種新語言。

examples.source: They decided to invest in the company when it started.
examples.target: 當這間公司剛開始時，他們決定投資它。

examples.source: You should invest in your education to have a better future.
examples.target: 你應該投資於自己的教育，這樣才會有更好的未來。

examples.source: My father decided to invest in a new small business today.
examples.target: 我爸爸今天決定投資一門新的小生意。

examples.source: It is wise to invest in good shoes if you walk often.
examples.target: 如果你經常走路，投資一雙好鞋是明智的。

examples.source: My parents want to invest in my future education.
examples.target: 我父母想投資於我未來的教育。

examples.source: It is wise to invest in a good dictionary.
examples.target: 投資於一本好的字典是明智的。

examples.source: They plan to invest in new computers for the school.
examples.target: 他們計劃為學校投資於新電腦。

examples.source: The police will investigate the cause of the fire today.
examples.target: 警方今天會調查這場火警的起因。

examples.source: We need to investigate why the computer is not working.
examples.target: 我們需要調查為什麼這台電腦無法運作。

examples.source: The reporter is investigating the new school lunch program.
examples.target: 那位記者正在調查新的學校午膳計劃。

examples.source: A cold shower can invigorate you in the morning.
examples.target: 早上沖個冷水澡可以令你精神煥發。

examples.source: The fresh mountain air helped to invigorate the tired hikers.
examples.target: 清新的山區空氣令疲憊的行山人士恢復活力。

examples.source: The music was so upbeat that it invigorated the whole crowd.
examples.target: 音樂節奏輕快，令在場所有人都感到振奮。

examples.source: Many students were involved in the school sports day.
examples.target: 很多學生都參與了學校的運動日。

examples.source: I want to be involved in the new art project.
examples.target: 我想參與這個新的藝術計劃。

examples.source: She is involved in all the decisions about the party.
examples.target: 派對的所有決定她都有份參與。

examples.source: I need to iron my school uniform before I go out.
examples.target: 我出門前需要熨好校服。

examples.source: My mother irons the shirts every Sunday evening for me.
examples.target: 媽媽每個星期日晚上都會幫我熨衫。

examples.source: Please iron this dress if it looks a bit wrinkled.
examples.target: 如果這條裙子看起來有點皺，請把它熨平。

examples.source: Iron is a strong metal used to make many things.
examples.target: 鐵是一種堅硬的金屬，可以用來製造許多東西。

examples.source: My mother uses an iron to smooth out my school shirts.
examples.target: 媽媽用熨斗把我的校服恤衫燙平。

examples.source: You should eat more spinach because it contains a lot of iron.
examples.target: 你應該多吃菠菜，因為它含有豐富的鐵質。

examples.source: It is irrational to be afraid of such a small spider.
examples.target: 害怕這麼小的一隻蜘蛛是不理性的。

examples.source: He made an irrational decision because he was very angry.
examples.target: 他因為非常生氣而做了一個不理性的決定。

examples.source: Please do not be irrational when we discuss this problem.
examples.target: 當我們討論這個問題時，請不要表現得不理性。

examples.source: The smell of fresh bread is simply irresistible to me.
examples.target: 新鮮麵包的香味對我來說簡直是無法抵抗。

examples.source: She found the cute puppy irresistible when she saw it.
examples.target: 當她看到那隻可愛的小狗時，覺得牠實在太討人喜歡了。

examples.source: It is hard to say no because the offer is irresistible.
examples.target: 因為這個提議實在太吸引人，很難拒絕。

examples.source: The smell of freshly baked bread was simply irresistible.
examples.target: 剛出爐麵包的香味實在令人無法抗拒。

examples.source: She found the offer of a free trip to Japan irresistible.
examples.target: 她覺得免費去日本旅行這個提議實在難以抗拒。

examples.source: He has an irresistible charm that makes everyone like him.
examples.target: 他有一種令人無法抗拒的魅力，令大家都喜歡他。

examples.source: It is irresponsible to leave your homework until the last minute.
examples.target: 把功課留到最後一刻才做，是非常不負責任的。

examples.source: He was irresponsible when he forgot to feed the pet dog.
examples.target: 他忘記餵寵物狗，行為很不負責任。

examples.source: The manager made an irresponsible decision that hurt the whole team.
examples.target: 經理做了一個不負責任的決定，傷害了整個團隊。

examples.source: Climate change can cause irreversible damage to our planet.
examples.target: 氣候變化可能會對我們的地球造成不可逆轉的損害。

examples.source: The decision to quit school had an irreversible effect on his future.
examples.target: 退學這個決定對他的未來產生了不可逆轉的影響。

examples.source: If you delete these files, the loss will be irreversible.
examples.target: 如果你刪除了這些檔案，損失將會是不可逆轉的。

examples.source: The loud music in the library began to irritate me.
examples.target: 圖書館裡嘈雜的音樂開始令我感到煩躁。

examples.source: It will irritate your skin if you touch that plant.
examples.target: 如果你觸摸那種植物，會刺激到你的皮膚。

examples.source: He likes to irritate his sister by hiding her books.
examples.target: 他喜歡透過藏起妹妹的書來激怒她。

examples.source: Traffic is very heavy on the Island Eastern Corridor this morning.
examples.target: 今早東區走廊的交通非常擠塞。

examples.source: We can see the sea when we drive along the Island Eastern Corridor.
examples.target: 當我們沿著東區走廊駕駛時，可以看到大海。

examples.source: The bus will take the Island Eastern Corridor to reach Central quickly.
examples.target: 巴士會取道東區走廊，以便快速到達中環。

examples.source: The school will issue a new notice to all students tomorrow.
examples.target: 學校聽日會向所有學生發出新通告。

examples.source: The government issued a warning when the typhoon came closer.
examples.target: 當颱風逼近時，政府發出了警告。

examples.source: The library issued me a new card after I lost mine.
examples.target: 我遺失圖書證後，圖書館補發了一張給我。

examples.source: We need to talk about this important issue today.
examples.target: 我們今天需要談論這個重要的議題。

examples.source: Pollution is a serious issue in our city.
examples.target: 污染是我們城市的一個嚴重問題。

examples.source: If you have any issue, please ask the teacher.
examples.target: 如果你有任何問題，請詢問老師。

examples.source: The government will issue a license to the new restaurant soon.
examples.target: 政府很快會向這間新餐廳發出牌照。

examples.source: They cannot issue a license if you do not pay the fee.
examples.target: 如果你不繳交費用，他們就不能發牌。

examples.source: The department decided to issue a license to the driving school.
examples.target: 該部門決定向這間駕駛學校發出牌照。

examples.source: It's time to go home because the library is closing.
examples.target: 因為圖書館快要關門了，所以是時候回家。

examples.source: It's time for us to start our group project now.
examples.target: 現在是時候開始我們的小組習作了。

examples.source: When the bell rings, it's time to change classrooms.
examples.target: 當鐘聲響起時，就是時候轉換課室了。

examples.source: It's time to clean our desks.
examples.target: 是時候清潔我們的書桌了。

examples.source: It's time for us to save water.
examples.target: 是時候讓我們節約用水了。

examples.source: It's time to protect our planet.
examples.target: 是時候保護我們的地球了。

examples.target: 請在你的文章中，將書名改為斜體字。

examples.target: 老師說要用斜體字來標示生字。

examples.target: 如果你想強調某個詞，你可以使用斜體字。

examples.target: 當你輸入書名時，請用斜體標示。

examples.target: 老師用了斜體字來標示重點詞彙。

examples.source: I wrote the foreign words in italic for my essay.
examples.target: 我在作文中把外語詞彙寫成了斜體。

examples.target: 在我們開始學校旅行前，請先檢查行程。

examples.target: 我們在日本度假的行程排得很滿。

examples.target: 她努力讀書，因為她想進入常春藤聯盟的大學。

examples.target: 如果你非常努力，你或許能進入常春藤聯盟的大學。

examples.target: 我努力讀書，為了考入理想的大學。

examples.target: 球隊每天練習，試圖贏得足球比賽。

examples.target: 他找了一份兼職，為了存錢買手提電腦。

examples.target: 學校增加了更多運動學會，以鼓勵學生過健康的生活。

examples.target: 他們降低了門票價格，以吸引更多年輕遊客。

examples.target: 政府種植了更多樹木，以改善城市環境。

examples.target: 米高佐敦是現今許多籃球小將心目中的國際偶像。

examples.target: 她在創立了受歡迎的服裝品牌後，成為了時尚界的代表人物。

examples.target: 這位歌手被世界各地忠實的粉絲視為文化偶像。

examples.target: 點擊資料夾圖示，就可以打開你儲存的功課檔案。

examples.target: 他是一位啟發了許多學生的流行音樂偶像。

examples.target: 在螢幕上找到設定圖示，就可以更改語言。

examples.target: 兩兄弟在運動日穿著完全相同的校服。

examples.target: 兩兄弟在運動日穿著一模一樣的校服。

examples.target: 這兩部手機看起來一模一樣，但它們的儲存容量不同。

examples.target: 我們在抽屜裡發現了兩條一模一樣的鑰匙，所以把它們都留下了。

examples.target: 我們學校的網站運作良好，所以沒問題就不要亂改。

examples.target: 魔術師製造了一個他能穿牆而過的幻象。

examples.target: 風暴過後，那座舊校舍的狀況很差。

examples.source: My bicycle is in a bad state because I never fix it.
examples.target: 因為我從不維修，所以我的單車狀況很差。

examples.source: If the road is in a bad state, please drive very slowly.
examples.target: 如果路面狀況很差，請務必慢駛。

in action.meaning: 在行動中 / 實際運作時

examples.source: We saw the firemen in action during the school drill.
examples.target: 我們在學校演習時，看見消防員正在行動。

examples.source: It is exciting to see a famous chef in action.
examples.target: 看見名廚在實際運作時，感覺真的很興奮。

examples.source: I watched the basketball team in action at the park.
examples.target: 我在公園看見籃球隊正在比賽。

examples.source: The sun disappeared behind the clouds in an instant.
examples.target: 太陽在瞬間消失在雲層後面。

examples.source: The hungry cat ate all its food in an instant.
examples.target: 那隻飢餓的貓在瞬間吃光了所有食物。

examples.source: The heavy rain started in an instant when we left.
examples.target: 我們離開時，大雨在瞬間傾盆而下。

examples.source: My mother buys rice in bulk to save some money.
examples.target: 我媽媽會大量購買米，這樣可以省點錢。

examples.source: The school buys stationery in bulk for all the students.
examples.target: 學校為所有學生批量購買文具。

examples.source: If you buy these snacks in bulk, they are cheaper.
examples.target: 如果你大量購買這些零食，價錢會便宜一點。

in case of emergency.meaning: 以防緊急情況 / 遇到緊急情況時

examples.source: Keep your phone charged in case of emergency.
examples.target: 請保持手機有電，以防緊急情況。

examples.source: Learn these safety rules in case of emergency.
examples.target: 遇到緊急情況時，請記住這些安全守則。

examples.source: We keep a first aid kit in case of emergency.
examples.target: 我們準備了一個急救箱，以防緊急情況。

examples.source: He is currently in debt because he bought a new car.
examples.target: 因為買了新車，他現在正處於負債狀態。

examples.source: If you are in debt, you should try to save money.
examples.target: 如果你負債的話，應該嘗試節省開支。

examples.source: They were in debt after they started their small business.
examples.target: 他們在創業之後就背負了債務。

in exchange for.meaning: 以...交換 / 作為...的交換

examples.source: I gave him my apple in exchange for his sandwich.
examples.target: 我用蘋果跟他交換了三文治。

examples.source: She offered her help in exchange for some extra time.
examples.target: 她提出幫忙，以換取額外的時間。

examples.source: They gave us information in exchange for our silence.
examples.target: 他們提供資訊給我們，作為我們保持沉默的交換。

examples.source: These bright colors are very in fashion this summer.
examples.target: 這些鮮豔的顏色在今年夏天非常流行。

examples.source: Long skirts are back in fashion again this year.
examples.target: 長裙今年又再次變得時興起來了。

examples.source: I do not buy clothes just because they are in fashion.
examples.target: 我不會只因為流行就去購買那些衣服。

in great shape.meaning: 身體狀態很好的 / 很健壯的

examples.source: He is in great shape because he exercises every single day.
examples.target: 他身體狀態很好，因為他每天都有做運動。

examples.source: You look like you are in great shape for the race.
examples.target: 你看起來狀態很好，已經準備好參加這場比賽了。

examples.source: If you want to be in great shape, you should eat healthy.
examples.target: 如果你想擁有健壯的體魄，就應該吃得健康一點。

examples.source: The boy stared in horror when he saw the broken vase.
examples.target: 當那個男孩看到打碎的花瓶時，他驚恐地瞪大眼睛。

examples.source: She looked in horror as the spider crawled across her desk.
examples.target: 當蜘蛛爬過書桌時，她驚恐地看著它。

examples.source: He drew back in horror because he almost touched the fire.
examples.target: 他因為差點碰到火，所以驚恐地退縮了。

examples.source: In modern times, people use smartphones to communicate with friends.
examples.target: 在現代，人們會用智能手機與朋友聯絡。

examples.source: Life is much faster in modern times than it was before.
examples.target: 與以前相比，現今的生活節奏快得多。

examples.source: In modern times, it is easy to find information on the internet.
examples.target: 在現代，我們很容易就能在網上找到資料。

examples.source: The old library is in need of some urgent repairs.
examples.target: 這間舊圖書館正需要進行一些緊急維修。

examples.source: Many stray cats are in need of a warm home.
examples.target: 許多流浪貓都需要一個溫暖的家。

examples.source: If you are in need of help, please ask me.
examples.target: 如果你需要幫忙，請告訴我。

examples.source: Please call the teacher if you are in need of assistance.
examples.target: 如果你需要協助，請聯絡老師。

examples.source: The charity provides food for people in need of assistance.
examples.target: 這間慈善機構為需要協助的人提供食物。

examples.source: He felt shy when he was in need of assistance.
examples.target: 當他需要協助時，他感到很害羞。

in one's own time.meaning: 在自己的時間 / 利用私人時間

examples.source: You can finish the reading project in your own time.
examples.target: 你可以利用私人時間完成閱讀報告。

examples.source: I prefer to study in my own time after school.
examples.target: 我比較喜歡在自己的時間放學後溫習。

examples.source: She likes to paint in her own time when she is free.
examples.target: 她喜歡在空閒時利用私人時間畫畫。

in one's own way.meaning: 以自己的方式 / 按自己的情況

examples.source: Everyone learns in their own way when studying for exams.
examples.target: 當準備考試時，每個人都有自己的學習方式。

examples.source: She likes to decorate her room in her own way.
examples.target: 她喜歡按自己的方式來裝飾房間。

examples.source: You should solve this math problem in your own way.
examples.target: 你應該用自己的方式去解決這道數學題。

examples.source: You can use honey in place of sugar for this cake.
examples.target: 你可以用蜂蜜代替砂糖來做這個蛋糕。

examples.source: We played a game in place of our usual lesson today.
examples.target: 我們今天玩了遊戲，代替了平時的課堂。

examples.source: I drank water in place of soda because I was thirsty.
examples.target: 因為我很渴，所以我喝水代替汽水。

examples.source: The school built a new library in response to student requests.
examples.target: 學校因應學生的要求，興建了一座新圖書館。

examples.source: We clapped loudly in response to the wonderful music performance.
examples.target: 我們為了回應那場精彩的音樂表演，大聲地鼓掌。

examples.source: The company lowered prices in response to the drop in sales.
examples.target: 公司因應銷售額下跌，調低了產品價格。

examples.source: I helped him with his homework in return for his advice.
examples.target: 我幫他做功課，作為他給我建議的回報。

examples.source: She gave me a gift in return for my kindness today.
examples.target: 她送了一份禮物給我，作為對我今天善意的回報。

examples.source: He shared his lunch with me in return for my help.
examples.target: 他跟我分享午餐，作為對我幫忙的回報。

examples.source: The explorers went into the forest in search of rare plants.
examples.target: 探險家們走進森林，尋找稀有的植物。

examples.source: Many young people move to the city in search of jobs.
examples.target: 許多年輕人為了尋找工作而搬到城市居住。

examples.source: The cat walked around the house in search of some food.
examples.target: 那隻貓在屋子裡走來走去，尋找一些食物。

examples.source: They met in secret because they wanted to plan a surprise.
examples.target: 他們秘密見面，因為想計劃一個驚喜。

examples.source: He practiced the song in secret so he could perform later.
examples.target: 他私下練習這首歌，以便稍後可以表演。

examples.source: The two friends planned the birthday gift in secret.
examples.target: 那兩位朋友秘密地計劃生日禮物。

in service.meaning: 仍在服務中的 / 營運中的

examples.source: This old bus is still in service after twenty years.
examples.target: 這輛舊巴士在二十年後仍然在服務中。

examples.source: The train is currently in service, so you can board now.
examples.target: 這列火車目前正在營運中，你可以現在上車。

examples.source: Is this lift still in service if the building is closed?
examples.target: 如果大樓關閉了，這部升降機還在服務中嗎？

examples.source: The movie was long and boring; in short, it was bad.
examples.target: 這部電影又長又悶，簡而言之，這是一部爛片。

examples.source: He lost his keys and wallet; in short, he had trouble.
examples.target: 他弄丟了鑰匙和錢包，簡而言之，他遇上了麻煩。

examples.source: The team played well and won; in short, they were great.
examples.target: 隊伍表現出色並贏得了比賽，簡而言之，他們真的很棒。

examples.source: This new pop song is already in the charts.
examples.target: 這首流行新歌已經在排行榜上了。

examples.source: His latest album stayed in the charts for weeks.
examples.target: 他最新的專輯在排行榜上停留了幾個星期。

examples.source: I am happy to see her song in the charts.
examples.target: 我很高興看到她的歌在排行榜上。

in the dark.meaning: 在黑暗中 / 甚麼都看不見的

examples.source: I felt scared when I was left in the dark.
examples.target: 當我被留在黑暗中時，我感到很害怕。

examples.source: It is hard to read a book in the dark.
examples.target: 在黑暗中看書是很困難的。

examples.source: Please turn on the light because I am in the dark.
examples.target: 請開燈，因為我甚麼都看不見。

examples.source: I should not have bought this phone in the first place.
examples.target: 我原本就不應該買這部電話。

examples.source: Why did you agree to help him in the first place?
examples.target: 你起初為什麼要答應幫他？

examples.source: We did not want to go out in the first place.
examples.target: 我們原本就沒有打算要出門。

examples.source: The author explains the main theme in the intro.
examples.target: 作者在引言中解釋了主題。

examples.source: I clearly stated my purpose in the intro.
examples.target: 我在引言中清楚地說明了我的目的。

examples.source: You should mention your key points in the intro.
examples.target: 你應該在引言中提及你的重點。

examples.source: Our school team is currently in the lead during the competition.
examples.target: 我們學校的隊伍在比賽中目前處於領先位置。

examples.source: She is in the lead because she practiced very hard every day.
examples.target: 她現在領先，因為她每天都非常努力練習。

examples.source: If we run faster, we will be in the lead again.
examples.target: 如果我們跑快一點，我們就能再次領先。

examples.source: We are in the process of moving to a new house.
examples.target: 我們正在搬去新屋的過程中。

examples.source: The team is in the process of planning the school trip.
examples.target: 團隊正在籌備學校旅行的過程中。

examples.source: They are in the process of fixing the broken computer now.
examples.target: 他們現在正在維修那部壞掉的電腦。

in the short term.meaning: 短期內 / 從短期來看

examples.source: We do not expect any changes in the short term.
examples.target: 我們預期短期內不會有任何改變。

examples.source: The price of fruit will rise in the short term.
examples.target: 從短期來看，水果的價格將會上升。

examples.source: It is hard to find a job in the short term.
examples.target: 要在短期內找到一份工作並不容易。

in the wild.meaning: 在野外 / 在自然環境中

examples.source: It is rare to see a giant panda in the wild.
examples.target: 在野外見到大熊貓是很罕見的。

examples.source: You should not feed animals when you see them in the wild.
examples.target: 當你在野外見到動物時，不應該餵飼牠們。

examples.source: These birds live in the wild and eat small insects.
examples.target: 這些雀鳥生活在野外，並以小昆蟲為食。

in the workplace.meaning: 在工作場所 / 在職場中

examples.source: It is important to be professional when you are in the workplace.
examples.target: 在職場中，保持專業是非常重要的。

examples.source: You should communicate clearly with your colleagues in the workplace.
examples.target: 你應該在工作場所與同事清楚溝通。

examples.source: We learn how to solve problems when we are in the workplace.
examples.target: 當我們在職場時，我們會學習如何解決問題。

examples.source: The students stood up in turn to read their essays aloud.
examples.target: 學生們輪流站起來朗讀他們的文章。

examples.source: If the economy grows, salaries will in turn increase for everyone.
examples.target: 如果經濟增長，大家的薪金亦會相應地增加。

examples.source: We played the game and took our turns in turn.
examples.target: 我們玩遊戲時輪流進行。

examples.source: Please check if the school printer is in working order.
examples.target: 請檢查學校的打印機是否運作正常。

examples.source: The computer is in working order after the teacher fixed it.
examples.target: 老師修好之後，這台電腦現在運作正常。

examples.source: We must ensure all the laboratory equipment is in working order.
examples.target: 我們必須確保所有的實驗室設備都運作正常。

examples.source: Please submit your formal complaint in writing to the office.
examples.target: 請以書面形式向辦公室提交你的正式投訴。

examples.source: You should confirm the agreement in writing to avoid mistakes.
examples.target: 你應該以書面形式確認協議，以避免出錯。

examples.source: The teacher asked us to explain our reasons in writing.
examples.target: 老師要求我們以書面形式解釋自己的理由。

examples.source: You need your parents' permission to make an in-app purchase.
examples.target: 你需要得到父母同意才可以進行應用程式內購買。

examples.source: This game is free, but it offers many in-app purchases.
examples.target: 這個遊戲是免費的，但它提供許多應用程式內購買項目。

examples.source: I disabled in-app purchases because I do not want to spend money.
examples.target: 我停用了應用程式內購買，因為我不想花錢。

examples.source: I read the in-flight magazine while waiting for my meal.
examples.target: 我等待機上餐膳時，閱讀了一本機上雜誌。

examples.source: The in-flight magazine has many photos of beautiful travel spots.
examples.target: 這本機上雜誌有很多美麗景點的照片。

examples.source: Please put the in-flight magazine back before we land.
examples.target: 請在飛機降落前將機上雜誌放回原位。

examples.source: I really enjoyed the in-flight meal on my trip to Japan.
examples.target: 我去日本旅行時，很享受那頓機上餐膳。

examples.source: The flight attendant served the in-flight meal after we took off.
examples.target: 飛機起飛後，空中服務員就派發機上餐膳。

examples.source: Please let the airline know if you need a vegetarian in-flight meal.
examples.target: 如果你需要素食機上餐膳，請通知航空公司。

examples.source: You can buy new outfits with in-game currency.
examples.target: 你可以用遊戲內的貨幣購買新服裝。

examples.source: I often chat with my friends during in-game events.
examples.target: 我在遊戲內的活動期間經常與朋友聊天。

examples.source: The in-game map helps us find the hidden treasure.
examples.target: 遊戲內的地圖幫助我們找到隱藏的寶藏。

examples.source: I saw an in-game ad while playing my favourite mobile game.
examples.target: 我玩最喜歡的手機遊戲時，看見一個遊戲內廣告。

examples.source: The in-game ad was annoying because it blocked the game screen.
examples.target: 那個遊戲內廣告很煩人，因為它遮住了遊戲畫面。

examples.source: The teacher reminded us not to click every in-game ad.
examples.target: 老師提醒我們不要點擊每一個遊戲內廣告。

examples.source: You can enjoy an in-store discount if you buy two shirts.
examples.target: 如果你買兩件襯衫，就可以享有店內折扣。

examples.source: The in-store service is excellent because the staff are very helpful.
examples.target: 店內服務非常好，因為職員都很樂意幫忙。

examples.source: I prefer in-store shopping when I want to try clothes on.
examples.target: 當我想試穿衣服時，我比較喜歡店內購物。

examples.source: The map is inaccurate, so we got lost in the park.
examples.target: 這份地圖不準確，所以我們在公園迷路了。

examples.source: His report was inaccurate because he used the wrong data.
examples.target: 他的報告不準確，因為他用了錯誤的數據。

examples.source: If the clock is inaccurate, you will be late for school.
examples.target: 如果時鐘不準確，你上學就會遲到。

inactive.meaning: 不活躍的 / 缺乏活動的

examples.source: He has been inactive in sports since he hurt his leg.
examples.target: 自從弄傷腿後，他在運動方面一直很不活躍。

examples.source: The old account became inactive because I did not use it.
examples.target: 因為我沒有使用那個舊帳戶，它現在已經失效了。

examples.source: If you remain inactive for too long, you will feel tired.
examples.target: 如果你長時間缺乏活動，你會感到疲倦。

examples.source: You should report any inappropriate content you see online.
examples.target: 你應該舉報你在網上看到的任何不適當內容。

examples.source: The website blocks inappropriate content to protect young students.
examples.target: 這個網站會封鎖不適當內容以保護年輕學生。

examples.source: If you find inappropriate content, please tell your teacher immediately.
examples.target: 如果你發現不適當內容，請立即告訴你的老師。

examples.source: Please check your inbox for the new homework assignment.
examples.target: 請檢查你的收件箱，看看新的功課指引。

examples.source: I found a message in my inbox from my teacher.
examples.target: 我在收件箱裡收到了一則老師發來的訊息。

examples.source: Empty your inbox if you want to receive new emails.
examples.target: 如果你想收到新郵件，請清空你的收件箱。

examples.source: You should record your income and expenses every single day.
examples.target: 你應該每天記錄你的收入與開支。

examples.source: We need to balance our income and expenses to save money.
examples.target: 我們需要平衡收入與開支，以便儲蓄。

examples.source: I made a table to track my monthly income and expenses.
examples.target: 我製作了一個表格來追蹤我每月的收入與開支。

incoming message.meaning: 傳入訊息 / 新收到的訊息

examples.source: My phone buzzed when an incoming message appeared on the screen.
examples.target: 當螢幕出現傳入訊息時，我的手機震動了一下。

examples.source: Please check your incoming message to see the new meeting time.
examples.target: 請查看你的傳入訊息，以確認新的會議時間。

examples.source: I missed the incoming message because my phone was in my bag.
examples.target: 因為手機放在袋子裡，所以我錯過了那則傳入訊息。

examples.source: The report is incomplete because I missed some important data.
examples.target: 因為我遺漏了一些重要數據，這份報告並不完整。

examples.source: Please do not hand in an incomplete homework assignment to me.
examples.target: 請不要把不完整的家庭作業交給我。

examples.source: The puzzle is incomplete since two pieces are missing now.
examples.target: 由於現在少了兩塊拼圖，這個拼圖是不完整的。

examples.source: I am sorry for the inconvenience caused by the late train.
examples.target: 對於火車延誤造成的不便，我感到非常抱歉。

examples.source: Please let us know if this change causes any inconvenience.
examples.target: 如果這個改動造成任何不便，請告訴我們。

examples.source: The construction work caused great inconvenience to the local residents.
examples.target: 建築工程對當區居民造成了很大的不便。

examples.source: He wants to start an independent life after he finishes university.
examples.target: 他想在大學畢業後開始獨立生活。

examples.source: Living away from home helps you learn about an independent life.
examples.target: 離家居住能幫助你學習過獨立生活。

examples.source: She is ready for an independent life because she can cook well.
examples.target: 她已經準備好過獨立生活，因為她很會煮飯。

examples.source: She pointed at the map with her index finger.
examples.target: 她用食指指向地圖。

examples.source: My index finger hurts because I cut it while cooking.
examples.target: 我的食指受傷了，因為我煮飯時不小心割傷它。

examples.source: If you are unsure, use your index finger to press the button.
examples.target: 如果你不確定，可以用食指按下那個按鈕。

examples.source: My brother plays the guitar in a local indie band.
examples.target: 我哥哥在一支本地獨立樂隊裡彈結他。

examples.source: They are an indie band that writes their own songs.
examples.target: 他們是一支會創作自己歌曲的獨立樂隊。

examples.source: We went to see an indie band perform last night.

examples.target: 請為我們的新客席講者準備一段介紹致辭。

examples.source: He felt nervous when he delivered his introductory speech today.
examples.target: 他今天發表介紹致辭時感到很緊張。

examples.source: All new staff must attend an introductory training course.
examples.target: 所有新員工都必須參加入門訓練課程。

examples.target: 我在入門訓練課程中學到了基礎知識。

examples.target: 如果你有興趣，請報名參加入門訓練課程。

examples.source: Thomas Edison was a famous inventor who created the light bulb.
examples.target: 湯瑪斯·愛迪生是一位發明了燈泡的著名發明家。

examples.target: 她長大後想成為一名發明家。

examples.target: 那位年輕的發明家整天都在研究他的新機器。

examples.source: You should use inverted commas for the title of the book.
examples.target: 你應該在書名上加上引號。

examples.target: 記得在別人說的話前後加上引號。

examples.source: If you are quoting a sentence, please use inverted commas.
examples.target: 如果你要引用句子，請使用引號。

examples.source: The water flows through an invisible tube inside the wall.
examples.target: 水流經牆內的一條隱形管道。

examples.target: 科學家設計了一條隱形管道來引導光線繞過物體。

examples.source: We cannot see the gas because it travels in an invisible tube.
examples.target: 我們看不見氣體，因為它是透過一條隱形管道傳送的。

examples.source: Please check the invoice before you pay the bill.
examples.target: 請在付款前檢查這張發票。

examples.source: The company sent us an invoice for the new computers.
examples.target: 公司給我們寄來了新電腦的發票。

examples.source: I will email the invoice to you when it is ready.
examples.target: 當發票準備好時，我會電郵給你。

examples.source: My new phone uses the latest iOS for better performance.
examples.target: 我的新手機使用最新的 iOS，運作起來更順暢。

examples.source: It is easy to update your iOS if you have Wi-Fi.
examples.target: 如果你有 Wi-Fi，更新 iOS 是很容易的。

examples.source: Some apps only work on the newest version of iOS.
examples.target: 有些應用程式只能在最新版本的 iOS 上運行。

examples.source: I wore my ironed shirt to the school interview today.
examples.target: 我今天穿了那件熨好的襯衫去參加學校面試。

examples.target: 請把熨好的衣服整齊地放進衣櫃裡。

examples.source: She looks smart when she wears an ironed uniform.
examples.target: 她穿上熨好的校服時看起來很精神。

examples.target: 這個動詞有一個很難記住的不規則形式。

examples.target: 他那不規則的睡眠習慣令他每天早上都感到疲倦。

examples.target: 因為今天交通擠塞，巴士服務變得不規則。

examples.target: 在公園亂拋垃圾是一種不負責任的行為。

examples.target: 他因為在學校有不負責任的行為而受到懲罰。

examples.source: If you continue this irresponsible behaviour, you will lose our trust.
examples.target: 如果你繼續這種不負責任的行為，你將會失去我們的信任。

examples.source: I felt irritated when my brother played music too loudly.
examples.target: 當我弟弟把音樂開得太大聲時，我感到很煩躁。

examples.target: 因為巴士今天又遲到了，她感到很惱怒。

examples.source: The constant noise from the street made me feel irritated.
examples.target: 街上持續不斷的噪音令我感到很煩躁。

island paradise.meaning: 島嶼樂園 / 天堂般的島嶼

examples.source: We spent our summer holiday on a beautiful island paradise.
examples.target: 我們在一個美麗的島嶼樂園度過了暑假。

examples.source: This island paradise is the perfect place to relax when you are tired.
examples.target: 當你感到疲倦時，這個島嶼樂園是放鬆的最佳地點。

examples.source: If you love the beach, you will enjoy visiting this island paradise.
examples.target: 如果你喜歡海灘，你一定會喜歡到訪這個島嶼樂園。

examples.source: The lighthouse will issue a signal to guide the ships home.
examples.target: 燈塔會發出信號，指引船隻回家。

examples.target: 裁判決定發出信號暫停比賽。

examples.target: 如果出現問題，這個裝置會發出信號。

examples.target: 我哥哥在一間大公司擔任資訊科技顧問。

examples.source: If you have computer problems, ask an IT consultant for help.
examples.target: 如果你遇到電腦問題，可以請教資訊科技顧問。

examples.source: The IT consultant helped us fix our office network yesterday.
examples.target: 那位資訊科技顧問昨天幫我們修好了辦公室網絡。

it platform.meaning: 資訊科技平台 / IT平台

examples.target: 我們學校使用一個資訊科技平台來分享功課和筆記。

examples.target: 你可以在這個資訊科技平台上找到有用的學習教材。

examples.target: 如果學生需要幫助，他們會登入資訊科技平台。

examples.target: 我們學校提供資訊科技培訓，幫助學生學習編程。

examples.target: 我參加了資訊科技培訓，因為我想提升我的電腦技能。

examples.source: If you finish the IT training, you will get a certificate.
examples.target: 如果你完成這項資訊科技培訓，你就會獲得一張證書。

examples.target: 因為天氣乾燥，我的皮膚感到非常痕癢。

examples.target: 即使你的手臂感到痕癢，也請不要抓它。

examples.target: 我的左腳被蚊子叮了，感覺很痕癢。

examples.target: 我因為對這款肥皂敏感，所以皮膚痕癢。

examples.target: 如果你的皮膚痕癢一直沒有好轉，就應該去看醫生。

examples.target: 盜獵者為了偷取珍貴的象牙而殺害大象。

examples.target: 現今販賣象牙製品是違法的。

examples.target: 這座舊鋼琴的琴鍵以前是用象牙製成的。

examples.source: Icarus is a figure from Greek mythology.
examples.target: 伊卡洛斯是希臘神話人物。

examples.target: 畫作顯示伊卡洛斯從天空墜下。

examples.target: 班上閱讀伊卡洛斯的故事。

examples.target: 工作坊以一個簡短破冰活動開始。

examples.target: 不偏不倚的報告會呈現雙方觀點。

examples.target: 從下面看，那座塔高得近乎不可能。

examples.target: 高跟鞋不適合長時間步行。

improvised.meaning: 即興的 / 臨時想出的

examples.target: 學校舉辦了首次音樂節。

examples.source: The mayor gave an inaugural speech.
examples.target: 市長發表開幕演說。

examples.source: The inaugural lesson introduced the course rules.
examples.target: 第一堂課介紹課程規則。

inaugurate.meaning: 為...舉行開幕 / 正式啟用

examples.source: The principal will inaugurate the new library.
examples.target: 校長將為新圖書館舉行開幕。

examples.source: The city inaugurated a new sports centre.
examples.target: 城市正式啟用一座新體育中心。

examples.source: A short ceremony inaugurated the exhibition.
examples.target: 一個簡短典禮為展覽揭幕。

inauthentic.meaning: 不真誠的 / 不地道的

examples.source: His apology sounded inauthentic.
examples.target: 他的道歉聽起來不真誠。

examples.source: The restaurant served inauthentic local food.
examples.target: 那間餐廳供應不地道的本地菜。

examples.source: Students can often notice inauthentic writing.
examples.target: 學生通常能察覺不真誠的文字。

incapacitate.meaning: 使失去能力 / 使無法行動

examples.source: The injury can incapacitate a player for weeks.
examples.target: 這次受傷可能令球員數星期無法行動。

examples.source: A power cut may incapacitate the whole system.
examples.target: 停電可能令整個系統失去運作能力。

examples.source: The illness did not incapacitate her completely.
examples.target: 疾病沒有令她完全失去能力。

examples.source: The school uses badges to incentivise reading.
examples.target: 學校用徽章激勵閱讀。

examples.source: Discounts can incentivise people to use public transport.
examples.target: 優惠可以以獎勵鼓勵人們使用公共交通。

examples.source: The app tries to incentivise daily practice.
examples.target: 這個應用程式嘗試激勵每日練習。

examples.source: The facility can incinerate medical waste safely.
examples.target: 該設施可以安全焚化醫療廢物。

examples.source: Old documents were incinerated for security.
examples.target: 舊文件因保安理由被燒毀。

examples.source: The report explains why some rubbish is incinerated.
examples.target: 報告解釋為何有些垃圾會被焚化。

examples.source: The speech did not incite violence.
examples.target: 那場演說沒有煽動暴力。

examples.source: False rumours can incite fear.
examples.target: 假謠言可以激起恐懼。

examples.source: The teacher warned students not to incite arguments online.
examples.target: 老師提醒學生不要在網上煽動爭吵。

examples.source: The match was cancelled because of inclement weather.
examples.target: 比賽因惡劣天氣取消。

examples.source: Bring a raincoat if the forecast is inclement.
examples.target: 如果天氣預報惡劣，請帶雨衣。

examples.source: The school has a plan for inclement weather.
examples.target: 學校有惡劣天氣安排。

examples.source: She has an inclination to help others.
examples.target: 她有幫助別人的傾向。

examples.source: He showed little inclination to join the club.
examples.target: 他沒有太大意向加入學會。

examples.source: My first inclination was to ask for advice.
examples.target: 我的第一個傾向是尋求建議。

examples.source: The school values inclusivity in every activity.
examples.target: 學校重視每個活動中的包容性。

examples.source: Good design improves inclusivity for all users.
examples.target: 良好設計能提升所有使用者的共融性。

examples.source: The poster promotes kindness and inclusivity.
examples.target: 海報推廣善意和包容性。

incognito.meaning: 隱姓埋名的 / 喬裝的

examples.source: The singer travelled incognito to avoid attention.
examples.target: 歌手隱姓埋名地旅行以避免注意。

examples.source: The detective went incognito at the hotel.
examples.target: 偵探在酒店喬裝行事。

examples.source: He used an incognito name in the story.
examples.target: 他在故事中使用隱藏身份的名字。

incomer.meaning: 外來居民 / 新搬來的人

examples.source: The village welcomed every incomer warmly.
examples.target: 村莊熱情歡迎每位新搬來的人。

examples.source: As an incomer, she needed time to learn local customs.
examples.target: 作為外來居民，她需要時間學習本地習俗。

examples.source: The club helps incomers make friends.
examples.target: 這個學會幫助新搬來的人交朋友。

examples.source: The mistake showed serious incompetence.
examples.target: 這個錯誤顯示嚴重無能。

examples.source: The report criticised the manager's incompetence.
examples.target: 報告批評經理不稱職。

examples.source: Training can reduce incompetence in a team.
examples.target: 培訓可以減少團隊中的不稱職情況。

examples.source: The instructions were incomprehensible to many students.
examples.target: 那些指示令很多學生難以理解。

examples.source: His handwriting was almost incomprehensible.
examples.target: 他的字跡幾乎難以理解。

examples.source: A good teacher can simplify incomprehensible ideas.
examples.target: 好老師能簡化難以理解的概念。

examples.source: The bright poster created an incongruity in the old room.
examples.target: 鮮艷海報在舊房間裡造成不協調。

examples.source: The joke depends on the incongruity of the situation.
examples.target: 笑話取決於情況的不一致。

examples.source: The critic noticed an incongruity in the design.
examples.target: 評論家注意到設計中的不協調。

inconsiderable.meaning: 微不足道的 / 不重要的

examples.source: The cost was not inconsiderable for a small school.
examples.target: 對一間小學校來說，這筆費用並非微不足道。

examples.source: He made a contribution that was far from inconsiderable.
examples.target: 他的貢獻絕非不重要。

examples.source: The delay was inconsiderable and caused no problem.
examples.target: 延誤微不足道，沒有造成問題。

examples.source: The teacher found an inconsistency in the answer.
examples.target: 老師在答案中發現一處不一致。

examples.source: Inconsistency in practice can slow progress.
examples.target: 練習參差會拖慢進步。

examples.source: The report explains the inconsistency between two results.
examples.target: 報告解釋兩個結果之間的不一致。

examples.source: The child was inconsolable after losing his pet.
examples.target: 孩子失去寵物後傷心得無法安慰。

examples.source: She felt inconsolable when the trip was cancelled.
examples.target: 旅程取消時，她傷心得無法安慰。

examples.source: His friends stayed with him while he was inconsolable.
examples.target: 他傷心得無法安慰時，朋友留在他身邊。

incontrovertibly.meaning: 無可爭議地 / 不容置疑地

examples.source: The evidence incontrovertibly proved the result.
examples.target: 證據無可爭議地證明了結果。

examples.source: The athlete was incontrovertibly the fastest runner.
examples.target: 那位運動員不容置疑地是最快的跑手。

examples.source: The data shows, incontrovertibly, that attendance improved.
examples.target: 數據無可爭議地顯示出席率改善了。

examples.source: She stared incredulously at the test score.
examples.target: 她難以置信地盯著測驗分數。

examples.source: He laughed incredulously when he heard the news.
examples.target: 他聽到消息時難以置信地笑了。

examples.source: The class looked incredulously at the tiny robot.
examples.target: 全班難以置信地看著那個小機械人。

incremental.meaning: 逐步增加的 / 漸進的

examples.source: Small incremental changes improved the app.
examples.target: 細小而逐步增加的改動改善了這個應用程式。

examples.source: The teacher prefers incremental progress.
examples.target: 老師較喜歡漸進的進步。

examples.source: Saving a little each week leads to incremental growth.
examples.target: 每星期儲一點錢會帶來逐步增長。

examples.source: The eggs need a warm place for incubation.
examples.target: 這些蛋需要溫暖地方孵化。

examples.source: The doctor explained the incubation period of the illness.
examples.target: 醫生解釋該疾病的潛伏期。

examples.source: The science club observed incubation in the classroom.
examples.target: 科學學會在課室觀察孵化過程。

examples.source: The chicks stayed warm in an incubator.
examples.target: 小雞在孵化器裡保持溫暖。

examples.source: The start-up joined a business incubator.
examples.target: 那間初創公司加入了一個企業培育機構。

examples.source: An incubator helps fragile babies stay safe.
examples.target: 孵化保溫箱幫助脆弱嬰兒保持安全。

examples.source: It is incumbent on leaders to act fairly.
examples.target: 領袖有責任公平行事。

examples.source: The incumbent president answered questions from reporters.
examples.target: 現任總統回答記者提問。

examples.source: It is incumbent upon students to respect others.
examples.target: 學生有責任尊重別人。

examples.source: The village reported an incursion by wild animals.
examples.target: 村莊報告有野生動物闖入。

examples.source: The army stopped the border incursion.
examples.target: 軍隊阻止了邊境侵擾。

examples.source: Online scams are an incursion into personal safety.
examples.target: 網上騙案是對個人安全的侵擾。

examples.source: I am indebted to my teacher for her patience.
examples.target: 我很感激老師的耐心。

examples.source: The team felt indebted to the volunteers.
examples.target: 團隊覺得欠義工一份人情。

examples.source: She is deeply indebted to her family.
examples.target: 她深深感激自己的家人。

indefensible.meaning: 站不住腳的 / 無法辯護的

examples.source: His rude behaviour was indefensible.
examples.target: 他的無禮行為是無法辯護的。

examples.source: The argument became indefensible after new evidence appeared.
examples.target: 新證據出現後，這個論點變得站不住腳。

examples.source: Wasting food while others are hungry is indefensible.
examples.target: 別人捱餓時浪費食物是無法辯護的。

indelible.meaning: 難以磨滅的 / 深刻的

examples.source: The trip left an indelible memory.
examples.target: 那次旅程留下難以磨滅的記憶。

examples.source: The teacher made an indelible impression on her students.
examples.target: 老師給學生留下深刻印象。

examples.source: Use an indelible pen for the label.
examples.target: 標籤請使用難以擦掉的筆。

examples.source: The concert was indelibly marked in her memory.
examples.target: 那場音樂會難以磨滅地留在她記憶中。

examples.source: His kindness was indelibly remembered by the class.
examples.target: 他的善意被全班難以磨滅地記住。

examples.source: The date was indelibly printed on the ticket.
examples.target: 日期難以擦掉地印在門票上。

examples.source: The rising temperature is indicative of climate change.
examples.target: 氣溫上升顯示氣候變化。

examples.source: Her smile was indicative of relief.
examples.target: 她的笑容表明她鬆了一口氣。

examples.source: Low scores may be indicative of a difficult test.
examples.target: 低分可能顯示測驗很困難。

indigestible.meaning: 難消化的 / 難理解的

examples.source: The meal was too heavy and indigestible.
examples.target: 那餐太膩，難以消化。

examples.source: The report was full of indigestible data.
examples.target: 報告充滿難理解的數據。

examples.source: The teacher turned indigestible ideas into simple notes.
examples.target: 老師把難理解的概念變成簡單筆記。

indirection.meaning: 間接方式 / 迂迴表達

examples.source: She used indirection instead of saying no directly.
examples.target: 她使用迂迴表達，而不是直接說不。

examples.source: The poem uses indirection to suggest sadness.
examples.target: 這首詩用間接方式暗示悲傷。

examples.source: Indirection can make a message sound more polite.
examples.target: 迂迴表達可以令訊息聽起來更有禮貌。

indiscriminately.meaning: 不加選擇地 / 胡亂地

examples.source: Do not share links indiscriminately online.
examples.target: 不要在網上胡亂分享連結。

examples.source: The machine sprayed water indiscriminately.
examples.target: 機器不加選擇地噴水。

examples.source: Choosing answers indiscriminately will not help learning.
examples.target: 胡亂選答案不會幫助學習。

examples.source: Water and a map are hiking indispensables.
examples.target: 水和地圖是遠足不可缺少之物。

examples.source: She packed her travel indispensables first.
examples.target: 她先收拾旅行不可缺少之物。

examples.source: A notebook is one of my study indispensables.
examples.target: 筆記簿是我學習中不可缺少之物之一。

examples.source: The evidence is indisputable.
examples.target: 證據是無可爭辯的。

examples.source: Her talent as a singer is indisputable.
examples.target: 她作為歌手的才華是無可爭辯的。

examples.source: Clean water is an indisputable need.
examples.target: 清潔食水是無可爭辯的需要。

indistinguishable.meaning: 難以分辨的 / 幾乎一樣的

examples.source: The twins looked almost indistinguishable.
examples.target: 那對雙胞胎看起來幾乎難以分辨。

examples.source: The copy was indistinguishable from the original.
examples.target: 複製品和原本幾乎一樣。

examples.source: The two sounds are indistinguishable to beginners.
examples.target: 對初學者來說，兩個聲音難以分辨。

examples.source: The culture is often described as individualistic.
examples.target: 這種文化常被形容為個人主義的。

examples.source: An individualistic student may prefer working alone.
examples.target: 個人主義的學生可能較喜歡獨自工作。

examples.source: The essay compares individualistic and cooperative values.
examples.target: 文章比較個人主義和合作價值。

examples.source: Each student received an individualized learning plan.
examples.target: 每位學生都收到一份個人化學習計劃。

examples.source: The app gives individualized practice after mistakes.
examples.target: 這個應用程式會在出錯後提供個人化練習。

examples.source: Individualized feedback helps students improve faster.
examples.target: 個人化回饋幫助學生更快進步。

examples.source: Education should not indoctrinate students.
examples.target: 教育不應向學生灌輸思想。

examples.source: The article warned that propaganda can indoctrinate young people.
examples.target: 文章警告宣傳可以向年輕人灌輸思想。

examples.source: Good teachers encourage thinking rather than indoctrinate.
examples.target: 好老師鼓勵思考，而不是灌輸思想。

examples.source: The club will induct new members next week.
examples.target: 學會下星期會正式吸納新會員。

examples.source: The ceremony inducted her into the hall of fame.
examples.target: 典禮正式把她納入名人堂。

examples.source: New teachers are inducted before the school year begins.
examples.target: 新老師在學年開始前接受入職安排。

induction.meaning: 就職 / 入門訓練 / 感應

examples.source: New staff attended an induction session.
examples.target: 新員工參加了入門訓練。

examples.source: Her induction into the society was held on Friday.
examples.target: 她加入該學會的就職儀式在星期五舉行。

examples.source: The science lesson introduced magnetic induction.
examples.target: 科學課介紹了磁感應。

examples.source: The industrialist built factories in several cities.
examples.target: 那位實業家在幾個城市建立工廠。

examples.source: A famous industrialist donated money to the school.
examples.target: 一位著名工業家向學校捐款。

examples.source: The museum tells the story of a local industrialist.
examples.target: 博物館講述一位本地實業家的故事。

industrially.meaning: 工業上 / 以工業方式

examples.source: The chemical is produced industrially.
examples.target: 這種化學品以工業方式生產。

examples.source: The area became industrially important.
examples.target: 該地區在工業上變得重要。

examples.source: Industrially made food can be cheaper.
examples.target: 以工業方式製造的食物可以較便宜。

examples.source: The old rule was ineffectual.
examples.target: 舊規則是無效的。

examples.source: An ineffectual plan wastes time.
examples.target: 無效的計劃會浪費時間。

examples.source: The medicine was ineffectual for his headache.
examples.target: 這藥對他的頭痛無效。

examples.source: The conclusion was inescapable after the evidence.
examples.target: 有了證據後，結論是無法逃避的。

examples.source: Homework is an inescapable part of school life.
examples.target: 家課是校園生活中無法逃避的一部分。

examples.source: The smell of fresh bread was inescapable.
examples.target: 新鮮麵包的香味令人無法避開。

inevitability.meaning: 必然發生的事 / 必然性

examples.source: The film explores the inevitability of change.
examples.target: 電影探討改變的必然性。

examples.source: The team accepted the inevitability of extra practice.
examples.target: 隊伍接受加操是必然發生的事。

examples.source: Ageing is an inevitability of life.
examples.target: 衰老是人生中必然發生的事。

inexcusable.meaning: 不可原諒的 / 無法辯解的

examples.source: Cheating in an exam is inexcusable.
examples.target: 考試作弊是不可原諒的。

examples.source: The delay was inexcusable because everyone was ready.
examples.target: 延誤無法辯解，因為大家都準備好了。

examples.source: It is inexcusable to ignore a safety warning.
examples.target: 漠視安全警告是不可原諒的。

examples.source: There was an inexplicable noise in the hall.
examples.target: 大堂傳來無法解釋的聲音。

examples.source: His sudden change of mood was inexplicable.
examples.target: 他情緒突然改變，令人無法解釋。

examples.source: The scientist studied the inexplicable result again.
examples.target: 科學家再次研究那個無法解釋的結果。

infamously.meaning: 臭名昭著地 / 出名地

examples.source: The road is infamously busy during rush hour.
examples.target: 這條路在繁忙時間出名地擠塞。

examples.source: The old test was infamously difficult.
examples.target: 舊測驗出名地困難。

examples.source: The leader was infamously cruel in history books.
examples.target: 歷史書中，那位領袖臭名昭著地殘酷。

examples.source: His infatuation with the new game lasted a week.
examples.target: 他對新遊戲的一時著迷持續了一星期。

examples.source: The novel describes a teenager's infatuation.
examples.target: 小說描寫一名青少年的迷戀。

examples.source: Infatuation can fade when people know each other better.
examples.target: 當人們更了解彼此時，迷戀可能會消退。

examples.source: The school called experts to handle the termite infestation.
examples.target: 學校請專家處理白蟻大量滋生。

examples.source: A mosquito infestation can follow heavy rain.
examples.target: 大雨後可能出現蚊蟲大量滋生。

examples.source: Clean storage helps prevent infestation.
examples.target: 乾淨的儲物環境有助防止害蟲侵擾。

infested.meaning: 充滿害蟲的 / 被大量侵擾的

examples.source: The old cupboard was infested with insects.
examples.target: 舊櫃充滿害蟲。

examples.source: They cleaned the infested room carefully.
examples.target: 他們小心清潔被大量侵擾的房間。

examples.source: The farmer removed infested leaves from the plant.
examples.target: 農夫從植物上移除有害蟲的葉子。

examples.source: The doctor checked the inflammatory reaction on her skin.
examples.target: 醫生檢查她皮膚上的發炎反應。

examples.source: The website removed inflammatory comments.
examples.target: 網站移除了煽動性的留言。

examples.source: Some foods may worsen inflammatory conditions.
examples.target: 有些食物可能令發炎情況惡化。

examples.source: The player received a warning for a minor infraction.
examples.target: 球員因一次輕微違規收到警告。

examples.source: Parking there is a traffic infraction.
examples.target: 在那裡泊車是交通違例。

examples.source: The school records each serious infraction.
examples.target: 學校記錄每次嚴重違規。

examples.source: The camera uses infrared light at night.
examples.target: 相機在晚上使用紅外線光。

examples.source: An infrared sensor can detect heat.
examples.target: 紅外線感應器可以偵測熱力。

examples.source: The remote control sends an infrared signal.
examples.target: 遙控器發出紅外線訊號。

examples.source: The unfair rule began to infuriate the players.
examples.target: 不公平的規則開始令球員暴怒。

examples.source: Loud noise can infuriate tired neighbours.
examples.target: 巨大噪音可以令疲倦的鄰居暴怒。

examples.source: The delay did not infuriate her because she was patient.
examples.target: 延誤沒有令她暴怒，因為她很有耐性。

examples.source: The computer froze infuriatingly before the lesson.
examples.target: 電腦在上課前令人惱火地停住了。

examples.source: The answer was infuriatingly close but still wrong.
examples.target: 答案令人惱火地接近正確，卻仍然錯了。

examples.source: The bus arrived infuriatingly late.
examples.target: 巴士令人惱火地遲到。

examples.source: The teacher tried to infuse the lesson with fun.
examples.target: 老師嘗試讓課堂充滿樂趣。

examples.source: Lemon can infuse water with a fresh taste.
examples.target: 檸檬可以為水注入清新味道。

examples.source: The speech infused the team with confidence.
examples.target: 演說令團隊充滿信心。

examples.source: The bridge shows great engineering ingenuity.
examples.target: 這座橋展現出很高的工程巧思。

examples.source: Students used ingenuity to solve the problem.
examples.target: 學生用創意解決問題。

examples.source: Her small invention was full of ingenuity.
examples.target: 她的小發明充滿巧思。

examples.source: Daily reading can ingrain good language habits.
examples.target: 每日閱讀可以使良好語文習慣根深蒂固。

examples.source: The coach tried to ingrain teamwork in the players.
examples.target: 教練嘗試讓團隊合作在球員心中根深蒂固。

examples.target: 這幅漫畫以不莊重的方式看政治。

examples.source: His irreverent joke was not suitable for the ceremony.
examples.target: 他不敬的笑話不適合典禮。

examples.source: The book has an irreverent tone.
examples.target: 這本書語氣不太莊重。

examples.source: The decision changed their lives irrevocably.
examples.target: 這個決定無法挽回地改變了他們的人生。

examples.source: The file was irrevocably deleted.
examples.target: 檔案被無法挽回地刪除了。

examples.source: The village was irrevocably shaped by the new road.
examples.target: 新道路無法挽回地塑造了這條村。

irritant.meaning: 刺激物 / 惹人煩的事物

examples.source: Dust can be an irritant for the eyes.
examples.target: 灰塵可以是眼睛的刺激物。

examples.source: The slow internet became a daily irritant.
examples.target: 緩慢網絡成為每天惹人煩的事。

examples.source: The label warns that the liquid is an irritant.
examples.target: 標籤警告這種液體是刺激物。

isan.meaning: 依善 / 泰國東北部地區

examples.source: Isan is a region in northeastern Thailand.
examples.target: 依善是泰國東北部地區。

examples.source: The restaurant serves Isan food.
examples.target: 這間餐廳供應依善菜。

examples.source: The travel article introduced music from Isan.
examples.target: 旅遊文章介紹依善地區的音樂。

isolating.meaning: 令人孤立的 / 使人感到孤單的

examples.source: Moving to a new city can feel isolating.
examples.target: 搬到新城市可能令人感到孤單。

examples.source: Online learning was isolating for some students.
examples.target: 網上學習對有些學生來說令人孤立。

examples.source: A friendly club can make school less isolating.
examples.target: 友善的學會可以令學校生活不那麼孤單。

examples.source: The chemistry article mentioned isovaleric acid.
examples.target: 化學文章提到異戊酸。

examples.source: Isovaleric compounds can have a strong smell.
examples.target: 異戊酸化合物可能有強烈氣味。

examples.source: Students saw the word isovaleric in a lab report.
examples.target: 學生在實驗報告中看到 isovaleric 這個詞。

examples.source: This is the third iteration of the app.
examples.target: 這是應用程式的第三個版本。

examples.source: Each iteration of the design became simpler.
examples.target: 設計的每個版本都變得更簡潔。

examples.source: The story has appeared in many iterations.
examples.target: 這個故事以很多形式出現過。

ithaka.meaning: 伊薩卡（象徵人生目的地）

examples.source: In the poem, Ithaka represents a life destination.
examples.target: 在詩中，伊薩卡象徵人生目的地。

examples.source: The teacher explained the symbol of Ithaka.
examples.target: 老師解釋伊薩卡這個象徵。

examples.source: Ithaka reminds readers to value the journey.
examples.target: 伊薩卡提醒讀者珍惜旅程。

examples.source: The itinerant teacher visited several villages.
examples.target: 那位巡迴老師探訪了幾條村。

examples.source: An itinerant theatre group performed at the school.
examples.target: 一個巡迴劇團在學校表演。

examples.source: The story follows an itinerant musician.
examples.target: 故事講述一位流動音樂人。

examples.source: The patient was in a coma for several days.
examples.target: 病人昏迷了數天。

examples.source: The news said the driver was in a coma.
examples.target: 新聞指司機昏迷中。

examples.source: Doctors cared for the child in a coma.
examples.target: 醫生照顧昏迷中的孩子。

examples.source: The suspect remained in custody overnight.
examples.target: 疑犯整晚被拘留。

examples.source: Police said the man was in custody.
examples.target: 警方表示該男子在羈押中。

examples.source: The court decided he should stay in custody.
examples.target: 法庭決定他應繼續被拘留。

examples.source: The firefighter was injured in the line of duty.
examples.target: 消防員因公受傷。

examples.source: Police officers face risks in the line of duty.
examples.target: 警員執勤時面對風險。

examples.source: The nurse helped many people in the line of duty.
examples.target: 護士因公幫助了很多人。

if my life depended on it.meaning: 即使性命攸關也做不到

examples.source: I could not sing that song if my life depended on it.
examples.target: 即使性命攸關，我也唱不到那首歌。

examples.source: He cannot draw a straight line if his life depended on it.
examples.target: 即使性命攸關，他也畫不到直線。

examples.source: She could not remember the password if her life depended on it.
examples.target: 即使性命攸關，她也記不起密碼。

examples.source: If the survey is anything to go by, students like the new app.
examples.target: 如果從調查來看，學生喜歡新應用程式。

examples.source: If last year is anything to go by, the event will be busy.
examples.target: 如果從去年來看，活動會很繁忙。

examples.source: If the first chapter is anything to go by, the book is excellent.
examples.target: 如果從第一章來看，這本書很出色。

if you can't take the heat, get out of t.meaning: 受不了壓力就不要參與

examples.source: The coach said, if you can't take the heat, get out of the kitchen.
examples.target: 教練說，受不了壓力就不要參與。

examples.source: The phrase means people should accept pressure in a tough role.
examples.target: 這句話意思是人在艱難角色中應接受壓力。

examples.source: In debate, if you can't take the heat, get out of the kitchen.
examples.target: 在辯論中，受不了壓力就不要參與。

examples.source: A good book can ignite a student's fire.
examples.target: 一本好書可以激發學生的熱情。

examples.source: The speech ignited her fire for science.
examples.target: 演說激發了她對科學的熱情。

examples.source: The teacher hopes to ignite their fire for learning.
examples.target: 老師希望激發他們對學習的熱情。

examples.source: The room is ill-suited to group work.
examples.target: 這房間不適合小組活動。

examples.source: The old system is ill-suited to modern needs.
examples.target: 舊系統不適合現代需要。

examples.source: This example is ill-suited to young learners.
examples.target: 這個例子不適合年幼學習者。

examples.source: Noise can impinge on students' concentration.
examples.target: 噪音會影響學生專注。

examples.source: The new rule may impinge on personal freedom.
examples.target: 新規則可能妨礙個人自由。

examples.source: Long journeys impinge on family time.
examples.target: 長途交通會影響家庭時間。

implicated in.meaning: 與...有關的 / 被牽涉於

examples.source: Several factors are implicated in the problem.
examples.target: 幾個因素與這個問題有關。

examples.source: The report says the company was implicated in the delay.
examples.target: 報告指公司被牽涉於延誤。

examples.source: Poor planning was implicated in the failure.
examples.target: 規劃不足與失敗有關。

impose one's values on.meaning: 把自己的價值觀強加於

examples.source: Do not impose your values on every reader.
examples.target: 不要把自己的價值觀強加於每位讀者。

examples.source: The article criticises adults who impose their values on children.
examples.target: 文章批評把自己價值觀強加於孩子的成年人。

examples.source: Good discussion should not impose one person's values on the group.
examples.target: 良好討論不應把一人的價值觀強加於整個小組。

impossible to stomach.meaning: 完全不能接受的 / 難以忍受的

examples.source: The unfair decision was impossible to stomach.
examples.target: 這個不公平決定完全不能接受。

examples.source: The waste was impossible to stomach.
examples.target: 這種浪費令人難以忍受。

examples.source: For many readers, the ending was impossible to stomach.
examples.target: 對很多讀者來說，結局完全不能接受。

in a dark place.meaning: 處於低谷 / 情緒很差

examples.source: The character was in a dark place after losing confidence.
examples.target: 角色失去信心後處於低谷。

examples.source: She felt in a dark place, so she asked for help.
examples.target: 她覺得情緒很差，所以尋求幫助。

examples.source: The story begins with a student in a dark place.
examples.target: 故事由一名處於低谷的學生開始。

in a huff.meaning: 氣沖沖地 / 怒氣沖沖地

examples.source: He left the room in a huff.
examples.target: 他氣沖沖地離開房間。

examples.source: She shut the book in a huff.
examples.target: 她怒氣沖沖地合上書。

examples.source: The player walked away in a huff after the decision.
examples.target: 判決後，球員氣沖沖地走開。

examples.source: The design uses old colours in a nod to local history.
examples.target: 設計使用舊色彩，向本地歷史致意。

examples.source: The song begins with a line in a nod to her teacher.
examples.target: 歌曲開首一句向她的老師致意。

examples.source: The poster includes a red stamp in a nod to traditional art.
examples.target: 海報加入紅色印章，呼應傳統藝術。

in a similar vein.meaning: 以類似方式 / 同樣地

examples.source: In a similar vein, the second article discusses family pressure.
examples.target: 同樣地，第二篇文章討論家庭壓力。

examples.source: The teacher gave another example in a similar vein.
examples.target: 老師以類似方式給了另一個例子。

examples.source: In a similar vein, the film questions modern habits.
examples.target: 同樣地，電影質疑現代習慣。

in a single bound.meaning: 一躍之間 / 一下子跳過

examples.source: The hero crossed the gap in a single bound.
examples.target: 英雄一躍之間越過缺口。

examples.source: The cat jumped onto the wall in a single bound.
examples.target: 貓一下子跳上牆。

examples.source: The dancer moved across the stage in a single bound.
examples.target: 舞者一躍之間穿過舞台。

in a vacuum.meaning: 脫離背景地 / 孤立地

examples.source: We should not judge the sentence in a vacuum.
examples.target: 我們不應脫離背景地判斷句子。

examples.source: No policy exists in a vacuum.
examples.target: 沒有政策是孤立地存在的。

examples.source: The poem cannot be understood in a vacuum.
examples.target: 這首詩不能脫離背景地理解。

examples.source: The exam was held in accordance with the rules.
examples.target: 考試按照規則舉行。

examples.source: Please act in accordance with school policy.
examples.target: 請根據學校政策行事。

examples.source: The prize was given in accordance with the results.
examples.target: 獎項根據結果頒發。

in alignment.meaning: 排列一致 / 位置配合

examples.source: The pictures are in alignment on the wall.
examples.target: 牆上的圖片排列一致。

examples.source: Keep the title and image in alignment.
examples.target: 保持標題和圖片位置配合。

examples.source: The desks were in alignment before the exam.
examples.target: 考試前，書桌排列一致。

examples.source: In all likelihood, the match will be delayed.
examples.target: 比賽很可能會延遲。

examples.source: The book will, in all likelihood, become popular.
examples.target: 這本書十分可能會受歡迎。

examples.source: In all likelihood, she will choose science.
examples.target: 她很可能會選擇科學。

in and of itself.meaning: 本身 / 就其本身而言

examples.source: The idea is not bad in and of itself.
examples.target: 這個想法本身並不差。

examples.source: Technology, in and of itself, is not the answer.
examples.target: 科技就其本身而言並不是答案。

examples.source: The mistake was small in and of itself.
examples.target: 這個錯誤本身很小。

examples.source: The student stared at the question in bewilderment.
examples.target: 學生困惑地望著題目。

examples.source: She shook her head in bewilderment.
examples.target: 她困惑地搖頭。

examples.source: The class listened in bewilderment to the strange answer.
examples.target: 全班困惑地聽著奇怪答案。

in crowd.meaning: 受歡迎的一群 / 圈內人

examples.source: He wanted to join the in crowd at school.
examples.target: 他想加入學校中受歡迎的一群。

examples.source: The article questions why the in crowd has so much influence.
examples.target: 文章質疑為何圈內人有那麼大影響力。

examples.source: She did not care about being part of the in crowd.
examples.target: 她不在乎是否屬於受歡迎的一群。

examples.source: The old library is in dire need of repair.
examples.target: 舊圖書館急需維修。

examples.source: The village is in dire need of clean water.
examples.target: 村莊非常需要潔淨食水。

examples.source: Her essay is in dire need of clearer examples.
examples.target: 她的文章非常需要更清晰的例子。

examples.source: Please read the passage in entirety.
examples.target: 請完整地閱讀篇章。

examples.source: The speech was shown in entirety online.
examples.target: 演說在網上完整播放。

examples.source: We studied the poem in entirety.
examples.target: 我們完整地研讀這首詩。

in flux.meaning: 不斷變化的 / 未定的

examples.source: The timetable is still in flux.
examples.target: 時間表仍然未定。

examples.source: Teenagers' interests are often in flux.
examples.target: 青少年的興趣經常不斷變化。

examples.source: The market was in flux after the announcement.
examples.target: 公布後，市場不斷變化。

in free fall.meaning: 急速下跌的 / 失控下跌的

examples.source: Sales were in free fall after the bad reviews.
examples.target: 差評後，銷量急速下跌。

examples.source: Confidence was in free fall during the crisis.
examples.target: 危機期間，信心失控下跌。

examples.source: The chart shows prices in free fall.
examples.target: 圖表顯示價格急速下跌。

examples.source: The school launched a reading week in furtherance of literacy.
examples.target: 學校為促進讀寫能力舉辦閱讀週。

examples.source: The group met in furtherance of the project.
examples.target: 小組為推動項目而開會。

examples.source: The policy was made in furtherance of public health.
examples.target: 政策是為促進公共健康而制定。

in good company.meaning: 與優秀的人為伍的 / 身處好群體的

examples.source: If you enjoy reading, you are in good company.
examples.target: 如果你喜歡閱讀，你是與優秀的人為伍。

examples.source: The young artist is in good company at the exhibition.
examples.target: 年輕藝術家在展覽中身處好群體。

examples.source: Do not worry; many strong students make this mistake, so you are in good company.
examples.target: 不用擔心；很多優秀學生也會犯這錯，所以你並不孤單。

in its infancy.meaning: 處於起步階段的 / 尚在初期的

examples.source: The project is still in its infancy.
examples.target: 項目仍處於起步階段。

examples.source: Online learning was in its infancy then.
examples.target: 當時網上學習尚在初期。

examples.source: The club is in its infancy but growing quickly.
examples.target: 學會仍處於起步階段，但成長很快。

in its own right.meaning: 憑本身條件 / 本身就

examples.source: The app is useful in its own right.
examples.target: 這個應用程式憑本身條件已很有用。

examples.source: The short story is powerful in its own right.
examples.target: 這篇短篇故事本身就很有力量。

examples.source: The museum is famous in its own right.
examples.target: 博物館憑本身條件已很有名。

examples.source: Her English improved in leaps and bounds.
examples.target: 她的英文大幅進步。

examples.source: The young company grew in leaps and bounds.
examples.target: 這間年輕公司迅速成長。

examples.source: Technology has changed in leaps and bounds.
examples.target: 科技已迅速改變。

examples.source: We used a video in lieu of a live talk.
examples.target: 我們用影片代替現場講座。

examples.source: Students wrote a report in lieu of an exam.
examples.target: 學生寫報告代替考試。

examples.source: She sent an email in lieu of a letter.
examples.target: 她發電郵而不是寄信。

in moving terms.meaning: 以動人的說法 / 感人地

examples.source: She described her teacher in moving terms.
examples.target: 她以動人的說法描述老師。

examples.source: The article speaks in moving terms about family love.
examples.target: 文章感人地談及家庭之愛。

examples.source: He thanked his classmates in moving terms.
examples.target: 他以動人的說法感謝同學。

in no uncertain terms.meaning: 毫不含糊地 / 直截了當地

examples.source: The teacher explained the rule in no uncertain terms.
examples.target: 老師毫不含糊地解釋規則。

examples.source: She rejected the offer in no uncertain terms.
examples.target: 她直截了當地拒絕邀請。

examples.source: The notice says in no uncertain terms that phones are banned.
examples.target: 通知毫不含糊地說明禁止電話。

examples.source: He began painting in his autumn years.
examples.target: 他在晚年開始畫畫。

examples.source: She travelled more in her autumn years.
examples.target: 她年老時更多旅行。

examples.source: The writer became famous in his autumn years.
examples.target: 作者在晚年成名。

in one's back pocket.meaning: 可隨時使用 / 已準備好的

examples.source: Keep a few examples in your back pocket.
examples.target: 準備幾個可隨時使用的例子。

examples.source: She had a strong argument in her back pocket.
examples.target: 她已有一個準備好的有力論點。

examples.source: The team kept a backup plan in its back pocket.
examples.target: 團隊準備了一個可隨時使用的後備計劃。

in one's dna.meaning: 天生具有的 / 深植於本性的

examples.source: Creativity is in her DNA.
examples.target: 創意是她天生具有的特質。

examples.source: Helping others is in the school's DNA.
examples.target: 幫助別人深植於學校本性。

examples.source: Curiosity seems to be in his DNA.
examples.target: 好奇心似乎是他天生具有的。

in one's own backyard.meaning: 就在自己附近 / 在本地

examples.source: The problem exists in our own backyard.
examples.target: 問題就在我們自己附近存在。

examples.source: We found a great hiking trail in our own backyard.
examples.target: 我們在本地找到一條很好的行山徑。

examples.source: The article reminds us to notice issues in our own backyard.
examples.target: 文章提醒我們留意本地問題。

in one's own right.meaning: 憑自身實力 / 本身就

examples.source: She is a respected artist in her own right.
examples.target: 她憑自身實力成為備受尊敬的藝術家。

examples.source: The young player is talented in his own right.
examples.target: 年輕球員本身就有才華。

examples.source: The poem is important in its own right.
examples.target: 這首詩本身就很重要。

in one's right mind.meaning: 神智清醒的 / 理智正常的

examples.source: No one in their right mind would ignore that warning.
examples.target: 神智清醒的人都不會忽視那個警告。

examples.source: She asked if he was in his right mind.
examples.target: 她問他是否理智正常。

examples.source: Anyone in their right mind would check the answer first.
examples.target: 任何理智正常的人都會先檢查答案。

in perspective.meaning: 客觀看待 / 放在整體角度看

examples.source: Put the mistake in perspective and learn from it.
examples.target: 客觀看待錯誤，並從中學習。

examples.source: The chart helps us see the problem in perspective.
examples.target: 圖表幫助我們從整體角度看問題。

examples.source: A teacher can help students keep results in perspective.
examples.target: 老師可以幫助學生客觀看待成績。

in print.meaning: 仍在出版 / 仍可買到的

examples.source: The book is still in print after twenty years.
examples.target: 這本書二十年後仍在出版。

examples.source: Is this grammar guide still in print?
examples.target: 這本文法指南仍可買到嗎？

examples.source: Her first novel remains in print.
examples.target: 她的第一本小說仍在出版。

in real terms.meaning: 按實質計算 / 扣除通脹後

examples.source: Wages fell in real terms last year.
examples.target: 按實質計算，去年工資下跌。

examples.source: The price is lower in real terms than before.
examples.target: 扣除通脹後，價格比以前低。

examples.source: The budget did not grow in real terms.
examples.target: 按實質計算，預算沒有增長。

examples.source: She received a prize in recognition of her service.
examples.target: 她獲頒獎項，以表揚她的服務。

examples.source: The school held a ceremony in recognition of the volunteers.
examples.target: 學校舉行典禮表揚義工。

examples.source: He was thanked in recognition of his hard work.
examples.target: 他因努力工作而獲肯定。

examples.source: The project is broad in scope.
examples.target: 這個項目範圍很廣。

examples.source: The study is limited in scope.
examples.target: 這項研究在範圍上有限。

examples.source: The new plan is larger in scope than the old one.
examples.target: 新計劃在規模上比舊計劃更大。

in service of.meaning: 為了服務於 / 為了達成

examples.source: The app was built in service of better learning.
examples.target: 這個應用程式是為了服務更好的學習而建立。

examples.source: The writer changed the ending in service of the theme.
examples.target: 作者為了服務主題而改變結局。

examples.source: The rule exists in service of safety.
examples.target: 這條規則是為了達成安全而存在。

in situ.meaning: 在原本位置 / 在現場

examples.source: The painting was repaired in situ.
examples.target: 畫作在原本位置修復。

examples.source: Scientists studied the plants in situ.
examples.target: 科學家在現場研究植物。

examples.source: The old wall should be preserved in situ.
examples.target: 舊牆應在原本位置保育。

in tatters.meaning: 破碎不堪的 / 被摧毀的

examples.source: The old poster was in tatters.
examples.target: 舊海報破碎不堪。

examples.source: After the argument, their plan was in tatters.
examples.target: 爭論後，他們的計劃被摧毀了。

examples.source: The team's confidence was in tatters.
examples.target: 隊伍的信心破碎不堪。

in the clear.meaning: 已無嫌疑的 / 脫離麻煩的

examples.source: After checking the records, she was in the clear.
examples.target: 檢查紀錄後，她已無嫌疑。

examples.source: We are not in the clear until the report is finished.
examples.target: 報告完成前，我們還未脫離麻煩。

examples.source: The team was finally in the clear.
examples.target: 團隊終於脫離麻煩。

examples.source: He was in the employ of a local newspaper.
examples.target: 他受僱於一份本地報章。

examples.source: She spent ten years in the employ of the museum.
examples.target: 她為博物館工作了十年。

examples.source: The artist was once in the employ of a design company.
examples.target: 這位藝術家曾受僱於一間設計公司。

in the grand scheme of things.meaning: 從大局來看 / 整體而言

examples.source: In the grand scheme of things, one mistake is not huge.
examples.target: 從大局來看，一個錯誤並不嚴重。

examples.source: The delay is small in the grand scheme of things.
examples.target: 整體而言，延誤很小。

examples.source: In the grand scheme of things, learning matters more than marks.
examples.target: 從大局來看，學習比分數更重要。

in the hot seat.meaning: 被追問的 / 處於受壓位置的

examples.source: The captain was in the hot seat after the loss.
examples.target: 落敗後，隊長處於被追問的位置。

examples.source: During the interview, she was in the hot seat.
examples.target: 訪問期間，她處於受壓位置。

examples.source: The manager found himself in the hot seat.
examples.target: 經理發現自己被追問。

in the interest of.meaning: 為了...的利益 / 基於...考慮

examples.source: The rule was changed in the interest of safety.
examples.target: 規則基於安全考慮而改變。

examples.source: In the interest of fairness, everyone gets the same time.
examples.target: 為了公平，每個人都有相同時間。

examples.source: The meeting ended early in the interest of time.
examples.target: 會議基於時間考慮而提早結束。

in the know.meaning: 知情的 / 熟悉內情的

examples.source: People in the know expected the change.
examples.target: 知情人士預料到這個改變。

examples.source: Ask someone in the know before you decide.
examples.target: 決定前問一個熟悉內情的人。

examples.source: Students in the know arrived early for the event.
examples.target: 知情的學生提早到達活動。

in the market for.meaning: 有意購買 / 正在物色

examples.source: She is in the market for a new laptop.
examples.target: 她正在物色一部新手提電腦。

examples.source: The school is in the market for better chairs.
examples.target: 學校有意購買更好的椅子。

examples.source: If you are in the market for books, visit this shop.
examples.target: 如果你正在物色書本，可以去這間店。

examples.source: She stayed calm in the midst of the noise.
examples.target: 她在嘈雜聲中保持冷靜。

examples.source: The school changed its plan in the midst of the term.
examples.target: 學校在學期期間改變計劃。

examples.source: He found hope in the midst of difficulty.
examples.target: 他在困難之中找到希望。

examples.source: She wrote in the privacy of her room.
examples.target: 她在自己房間的私密空間中寫作。

examples.source: He practised the speech in the privacy of his home.
examples.target: 他在家中的私密空間練習演說。

examples.source: Students can reflect in the privacy of a journal.
examples.target: 學生可以在日記的私密空間中反思。

in the running.meaning: 有機會勝出 / 入圍的

examples.source: Our team is still in the running.
examples.target: 我們隊伍仍有機會勝出。

examples.source: She is in the running for the prize.
examples.target: 她入圍了這個獎項。

examples.source: Three designs are still in the running.
examples.target: 三個設計仍有機會勝出。

examples.source: The poem describes peace in the winter of life.
examples.target: 詩歌描寫人生暮年的平靜。

examples.source: He found new purpose in the winter of life.
examples.target: 他在晚年找到新目標。

examples.source: The story follows a painter in the winter of life.
examples.target: 故事講述一位晚年的畫家。

examples.source: In the words of my teacher, practice makes progress.
examples.target: 用我老師的話來說，練習帶來進步。

examples.source: In the words of the writer, the city never sleeps.
examples.target: 用作者的話來說，這城市從不睡覺。

examples.source: In the words of the captain, the team must stay calm.
examples.target: 用隊長的話來說，隊伍必須保持冷靜。

examples.source: The class answered in unison.
examples.target: 全班齊聲回答。

examples.source: The singers moved in unison.
examples.target: 歌手們一致地移動。

examples.source: The crowd shouted in unison.
examples.target: 人群齊聲叫喊。

examples.source: The dancers moved in unison with the music.
examples.target: 舞者與音樂配合地移動。

examples.source: The plan works in unison with the school's aims.
examples.target: 計劃與學校目標一致。

examples.source: The lights changed in unison with the song.
examples.target: 燈光配合歌曲變化。

examples.source: The poem expresses in-depth emotion.
examples.target: 詩歌表達深層情感。

examples.source: Good acting can show in-depth emotion.
examples.target: 好的演技可以展現深層情感。

examples.source: The novel explores in-depth emotion through simple scenes.
examples.target: 小說透過簡單場景探索深層情感。

in-your-face.meaning: 咄咄逼人的 / 張揚的

examples.source: The advertisement was loud and in-your-face.
examples.target: 廣告很吵，而且很張揚。

examples.source: His in-your-face style did not suit the formal event.
examples.target: 他咄咄逼人的風格不適合正式活動。

examples.source: The poster used an in-your-face design to grab attention.
examples.target: 海報使用張揚的設計吸引注意。

examples.source: I am indebted to my teacher for her advice.
examples.target: 我感激老師給我的建議。

examples.source: The team is indebted to the volunteers.
examples.target: 團隊感激義工們。

examples.source: She felt indebted to her parents for their support.
examples.target: 她感到欠父母支持的人情。

induct into.meaning: 使正式加入 / 接納入

examples.source: The new members were inducted into the club.
examples.target: 新成員被正式接納入學會。

examples.source: She was inducted into the hall of fame.
examples.target: 她被正式加入名人堂。

examples.source: The school inducted the prefects into their roles.
examples.target: 學校使領袖生正式開始履行職責。

intent on.meaning: 決心要...的 / 一心想...的

examples.source: She was intent on improving her writing.
examples.target: 她決心要改善寫作。

examples.source: The team is intent on winning the final.
examples.target: 隊伍一心想贏得決賽。

examples.source: He seemed intent on proving his point.
examples.target: 他似乎決心要證明自己的觀點。

examples.source: Parents are deeply invested in their children's learning.
examples.target: 家長十分關心子女的學習。

examples.source: The students were invested in the project.
examples.target: 學生投入於這個項目。

examples.source: She felt invested in the success of the team.
examples.target: 她很關心團隊能否成功。

examples.source: We need to iron out the problems before Friday.
examples.target: 我們需要在星期五前解決問題。

examples.source: The team ironed out the details in the meeting.
examples.target: 團隊在會議中消除細節問題。

examples.source: Practice helped iron out the mistakes.
examples.target: 練習幫助消除錯誤。

iron out the kinks.meaning: 解決小問題 / 修正毛病

examples.source: The app needs more testing to iron out the kinks.
examples.target: 應用程式需要更多測試來修正小毛病。

examples.source: We ironed out the kinks before the performance.
examples.target: 表演前，我們解決了小問題。

examples.source: The teacher helped us iron out the kinks in our plan.
examples.target: 老師幫我們修正計劃中的毛病。
